summary: 1935 L-601 tower with BC-301 cab in San Benito County; a 2006 caption calls it abandoned; land control and access sources conflict; no fire history found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Peakbagging's 2006 photo caption says the lookout is now abandoned; the 2019 Register entry describes it in the present tense and does not say it has been removed. The story treats it as standing but unstaffed and does not claim current condition.

The Register names the Cal Fire San Benito-Monterey Unit as administrator and says the site is behind locked gates. The Forest Fire Lookout Association table also lists Cal Fire as operator, but its status column says 'Private Property, no access', which suggests private land. The two sources do not conflict on the operator; the conflict is between the administrator and the private-property status. The story reports both and does not settle who owns the land.

notes_for_editor: Brief build year 1935 confirmed. Brief access 'unknown' set to closed on the Register's locked-gate note, with the land-control conflict stated. No fire history found. No staffing dates found; 'unstaffed' rests on the 2006 caption. The 2008 CAL FIRE lookout list (citlink.net PDF) text I could read does not name Call Mountain; not used. Archive.org also has a July 11, 1953 interior photo (casbcfm_001110) and the exterior photo above; license not verified, so no photos entry. The Forest Lookouts weebly page for this tower has no tower-specific history beyond an unrelated 1936 item. Story is about 280 words after fact-check edits.
